_comment: SAMPLE DATA — not real events. Used only by local `hugo server` when KIT_EVENTS_URL is unset. A production build refuses to use this file; see content/events/_content.gotmpl. Shape mirrors events.FeedItem in the Kit repo.

events.title: Trivia Night
events.summary: Six rounds, no phones, prizes for the top three.
events.description: Our long-running Tuesday trivia night. Teams of up to six, six rounds, and a picture round that has ended friendships. Prizes for the top three teams. No sign-up needed — just turn up.

events.title: Live Music: The Hollow Pines
events.summary: Front-range americana in the bier garten.
events.description: The Hollow Pines bring their three-part harmonies back to the bier garten for a summer evening set. Wood-fired pizza from Double D's until close.

events.title: Sourdough & Saison Pairing
events.summary: A guided five-course pairing. Twenty seats.
events.description: Our head brewer and the Double D's kitchen walk through five pairings, from a bright table saison to a barrel-aged farmhouse. Twenty seats only.

events.title: Great American Beer Festival
events.summary: Come find our booth in the Colorado hall.
events.description: We're pouring four beers at GABF this year, including something from the barrel program that has not left the building before.
